milestones.title: M0 - Foundation
milestones.description: Establish the technical and repository foundation for YummYummy: Laravel + Vue, Sail, PostgreSQL/Redis, authentication baseline, quality gates, CI/CD, and reproducible local development. Exit criterion: contributors can clone, start, test, and build the project consistently.

milestones.title: M1 - Groups & Members
milestones.description: Introduce the shared household/group boundary. Users can create and join groups, manage membership, and all domain data is correctly scoped and authorized by group. Exit criterion: cross-group data leakage is prevented by design and tests.

milestones.title: M2 - Inventory
milestones.description: Deliver the source of truth for what a group currently has: generic items such as macarrao 500 g, quantities, units, adjustments, and auditable inventory movements. Exit criterion: stock changes are deterministic and traceable.

milestones.title: M3 - Shopping List
milestones.description: Deliver a shared shopping list backed by explicit purchase demand rather than opaque quantity mutation. Items can be added, changed, removed, completed, and converted into inventory. Exit criterion: purchase actions and stock updates remain consistent.

milestones.title: M4 - Recurring Purchases
milestones.description: Automate repeat purchases using configurable intervals such as 3 days, 2 weeks, or 4 months. Rules generate idempotent shopping demand at the correct time and can be paused, resumed, or changed. Exit criterion: recurrence does not duplicate demand across scheduler runs.

milestones.title: M5 - Recipe Catalog
milestones.description: Create YummYummy's canonical recipe representation independent of source. Recipes contain portions, ingredients, quantities, units, steps, metadata, and provenance, allowing later import from datasets/APIs and AI-generated adaptations. Exit criterion: every recipe source normalizes to the same internal contract.

milestones.title: M6 - Recipe Matching
milestones.description: Recommend recipes deterministically from current inventory. Compute ingredient coverage, missing quantities, useful ranking factors, and explain why a recipe is suggested. Exit criterion: users can see what they can cook now and what is nearly available without relying on an LLM.

milestones.title: M7 - Meal Intent & Planning
milestones.description: Represent explicit user intent to cook/eat a dish. Requested meals receive ranking priority and badges, generate attributable shopping demand for missing ingredients, and can be cancelled without corrupting unrelated demand. Exit criterion: add/increment and reversal are provenance-safe.

milestones.title: M8 - YummYummy AI
milestones.description: Add natural-language interaction on top of existing deterministic application services. The LLM interprets requests into structured intents and approved tools but never mutates stock or shopping state directly. Exit criterion: common recipe/planning requests are safe, reversible, validated, and observable.

milestones.title: M9 - MVP Release
milestones.description: Harden the complete MVP journey for release: UX states, security, authorization, validation, accessibility, responsiveness, tests, performance baseline, seeds/demo data, deployment documentation, and end-to-end acceptance. Exit criterion: the full household-to-recipe-to-shopping-to-inventory flow is production-ready.
